Extract a named feature hierarchy from images

Source: R/hierarchy_extract.R
extract_feature_hierarchy.Rd

Runs one batched multi-output forward pass and applies a per-stage pooler. Convolutional activations are converted to NHWC before pooling. The virtual tap classifier_logits is computed from fc2 and the ImageNet classifier weights without applying softmax.

Usage

extract_feature_hierarchy(
  impaths,
  spec,
  model = NULL,
  batch_size = 16L,
  layout = c("nhwc", "nchw")
)

Arguments

impaths

Character vector of image paths, or a directory containing jpg/jpeg/png files.

spec

A vgg_hierarchy_spec or other feature_hierarchy_spec.

model

Optional preloaded Keras model. If NULL, the spec architecture is loaded with ImageNet weights.

batch_size

Images per forward pass.

layout

Layout of 4-D backend outputs; "nhwc" for Keras.

Value

A as_feature_hierarchy object.
